field.label: API Key
field.comment: Auto-generated during installation. Copy this key into your Horizon dashboard. To regenerate, clear the field and save. Requests must include header: X-Horizon-Key: your-api-key

field.label: Gateway URL
field.comment: Base URL of the Byte8 Horizon gateway (e.g. https://horizon.byte8.io or http://host.docker.internal:8085 for local dev). Used to push catalog invalidation webhooks. Leave empty to disable outbound webhooks.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Widget configuration (publishable key, name, color) is fetched automatically from the Horizon gateway using your API key. Enable the assistant for this store in your Horizon dashboard first.

field.label: Knowledge Pages
field.comment: CMS pages the assistant may quote when shoppers ask about delivery times, returns, refunds, payment or how to contact you. Leave empty to auto-detect pages whose title or URL key mentions shipping, delivery, returns, FAQ, customer service, contact, terms or payment. Page content is served as plain text via /horizon/api/v1/store-info.

group.label: Delivery Estimates
group.comment: Lets the assistant tell shoppers roughly when an order will arrive. Dates are computed by the module in the store timezone; the AI only reads them.

field.label: Handling Time (days)
field.comment: Days between an order being placed and being dispatched. Used for orders that haven't shipped yet and for quotes to new shoppers.

field.label: Count Business Days Only
field.comment: Yes = skip Saturdays and Sundays when adding handling and transit days.

field.label: Transit Times
field.comment: Min/max days in transit per carrier (optionally per method code, e.g. express). When a carrier has no row here, the assistant falls back to a time written in the method title, e.g. "Standard Delivery (3-5 days)"; otherwise it gives no date.
